Officials' homes raided, vast wealth including gold items seized

Authorities conducted raids on the residences of several government officials across Karnataka, alleging they amassed assets disproportionate to their known income. During the searches, significant amounts of cash and gold jewelry, including gold undergarments, were reportedly discovered. The value of the seized gold is currently being assessed.
